glosses: (heimlich) auftauchen (durch Zuwanderung oder Beitritt) und so tun, als ob man die Ziele teilt, während man eigentlich eigene Ziele verfolgt (zum Beispiel etwas öffentlich zu machen oder etwas zu zerstören oder umzuformen)

examples.text: „Er glaubt, daß wir, wenn man das richtig anstellt, den ganzen Nazi-Spionagering in Südamerika unterwandern und zerschlagen könnten.“

„Die Perser hatten es versucht und 150 Jahre vor Christi Geburt die Römer, die griechische Kultur wurde jedoch niemals für immer unterdrückt, im Gegenteil, sie unterwanderte massiv das römische Reich und besiegte alle Belagerer.“

translations.source_sense_description: nach und nach unmerklich (durch Zuwanderung oder Beitritt) in etwas eindringen, um es zu zersetzen

glosses: To surreptitiously penetrate, enter or gain access to.

examples.text: The spy infiltrated the high-tech company and stole many secrets.
Caithness was infiltrated with a palpable sense of being underimagined.

glosses: To cause to penetrate in this way.

examples.text: The agency infiltrated several spies into the company.

glosses: To pass through something by filtration.
To cause (a liquid) to pass through something by filtration.
To invade or penetrate a tissue or organ.

examples.text: High-grade tumors often infiltrate surrounding structures.
In certain conditions, immune cells may infiltrate into the cerebrospinal fluid.

Plesner et al. reported the nonbeta islet endocrine cell remodeling in diabetic NOD mice: that study suggested that infiltrating immune cells may restrict alpha-cell expansion in NOD mouse islet in the diabetic state [ 36 ].

glosses: To send (soldiers, spies, etc.) through gaps in the enemy line.
To move from a vein, remaining in the body.
Any undesirable substance or group of cells that has made its way into part of the body.

examples.text: One critical distinction to make is whether a focal corneal infiltrate is infected with bacteria or is a sterile immunologic response.
Extensive lumpy infiltrates with a tendency to caseate and to form fistulas with purulent secretions appear, mainly in the anogenital region.

Common immunohistochemical markers of this lymphoma include CD2, CD56, CD3, and T-cell receptors. 7 Typically, the histology of these lymphomas are characterized by monomorphic inflammatory cellular infiltrates, which may be diffuse or show angiocentricity and angiodestruction as well as tissue destruction. 7 Lymphoid markers from the nasal mucosal biopsy from this patient were negative for CD56 and EBER.

glosses: 渗透进（某个国家，地区，组织等）

examples.text: Die Germanen haben den römischen Staat unterwandert.
examples.translation: 日耳曼人已经进入到罗马国家的各个地方。

examples.text: Der Gegner versuchte, unsere Reihen zu unterwandern.
examples.translation: 敌人试图渗透到我们队伍内部。
